title: reference-impl: Plan agent prompt update for scope.files_touched and gate-pending summary format
definition_of_done: `reference-impl/prompts/plan.md` contains a new instruction block near the existing `task_dag` guidance directing the agent to populate `scope.files_touched` per task by transcribing repo-root-relative POSIX paths from the brief's Parallel-DAG conflict guidance section.
`reference-impl/prompts/plan.md` contains the explicit directive: "Do NOT manually add edges for file overlap. The system computes them automatically when the Plan is saved."

The gate-pending summary template in `reference-impl/prompts/plan.md` is updated to group edges under `Logical:` and `Inferred from file overlap:` subsections, with the Plan agent computing the diff inline.

A regression test in `reference-impl/tests/skills.test.ts` or a new `reference-impl/tests/prompts.test.ts` asserts that `prompts/plan.md` contains both the literal `scope.files_touched` instruction string and the directive not to manually add overlap edges.
The new or extended test file passes; no existing tests regress.
acceptance_criteria: `reference-impl/prompts/plan.md` contains the substring `scope.files_touched` in the context of a task-population instruction.
`reference-impl/prompts/plan.md` contains the literal directive text instructing the agent not to manually add edges for file overlap.
`reference-impl/prompts/plan.md` contains a gate-pending summary template with `Logical:` and `Inferred from file overlap:` edge groupings.
The regression test in `skills.test.ts` or `prompts.test.ts` asserts both required strings are present in `prompts/plan.md` and passes green.
